data.body:
fix-bug:investigation
ROOT_CAUSE: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md Step 6 (line 79) and Step 8.4 diagnostic (line 84) hardcode Python/Make/app-layout toolchain commands, bypassing the sprint orchestrator's config-resolved TEST_CMD/LINT_CMD/FORMAT_CHECK_CMD variables.

FIVE_WHYS:
1. Why do sprint sub-agents fail validation in non-Python projects? task-execution.md Step 6 instructs them to run 'make format-check && make lint from app/' and 'test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=app/tests'.
2. Why are these hardcoded? The template was written for the Python/Make/app-layout DSO reference project and was never parameterized.
3. Why isn't the sprint's config resolution passed into the template? The sprint SKILL.md resolves TEST_CMD/LINT_CMD/FORMAT_CHECK_CMD via read-config.sh at activation (lines 25-27) but only uses them for the orchestrator's own post-batch validation — it does not interpolate them into the task-execution.md template at dispatch time.
4. Why wasn't this caught earlier? For the DSO plugin project itself, the per-ticket Acceptance Criteria already carry correct 'Verify:' commands, so sub-agents that follow their ticket ACs validate correctly despite the wrong Step 6 boilerplate. The failure is masked.
5. Why is this a P2 and not P3? Every non-Python/polyglot sprint sub-agent will execute incorrect validation commands; projects that lack 'app/' or 'Makefile' with these targets will see hard failures at Step 6.

HYPOTHESES:
H1 (HIGH confidence): The fix is to add template placeholders {TEST_CMD}, {LINT_CMD}, {FORMAT_CHECK_CMD} to task-execution.md Steps 6 and 8.4, and update the sprint SKILL.md dispatch section (around line 1477/1521) to interpolate the config-resolved values when populating the template.
H2 (MEDIUM confidence): Alternatively, the sub-agent itself could resolve commands via '.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit' etc. inside Step 6 — this avoids needing orchestrator-side injection but requires the sub-agent to know the read-config interface.

EVIDENCE:
- task-execution.md line 79: hardcoded 'make format-check && make lint from app/' and '--runner=pytest --test-dir=app/tests'
- task-execution.md line 84: hardcoded 'make test-unit-only' and '--runner=pytest --test-dir=app/tests'
- sprint SKILL.md lines 25-27: TEST_CMD/LINT_CMD resolved via read-config.sh at orchestrator activation
- sprint SKILL.md line 1477: template filled with only '{id}' and '{escalation_policy}' — no command placeholders
- fix-bug SKILL.md lines 32-34: same pattern resolves FORMAT_CHECK_CMD too (not present in sprint SKILL.md)
- CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md lines 326-336: per-stack defaults exist for all commands.* keys, so read-config.sh returns correct stack-derived values
- Only one other file has these hardcoded patterns: task-execution.md (confirmed by grep across sprint/prompts/)

PREFERRED_FIX (H1):
1. In task-execution.md Step 6 (line 79): Replace 'make format-check && make lint from app/' with '{FORMAT_CHECK_CMD} && {LINT_CMD}' and replace '--runner=pytest --test-dir=app/tests' with '{TEST_CMD}'
2. In task-execution.md Step 8.4 (line 84): Replace 'make test-unit-only' with '{TEST_CMD}' in both occurrences and '--runner=pytest --test-dir=app/tests' with '{TEST_CMD}'
3. In sprint SKILL.md at dispatch site (line 1477): Add FORMAT_CHECK_CMD resolution (currently missing; fix-bug has it, sprint SKILL.md does not) and interpolate all three placeholders into the template before dispatch
4. Add a structural test asserting task-execution.md does NOT contain 'make format-check', 'make lint from app/', or '--test-dir=app/tests' literal strings (to prevent regression)

AFFECTED_FILES:
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md (lines 79, 84)
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (dispatch site ~line 1477, Config Resolution block ~line 25 — add FORMAT_CHECK_CMD)
- tests/hooks/test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh (or new test file) — add regression test

COMPLEXITY: TRIVIAL (text replacement + placeholder injection; no logic change)
FIXABLE: YES
MANUAL_APPROVAL_NEEDED: NO
COMPLEX_ESCALATION: NO
